description: The algorithm applied to facet counts before they are returned for an aggregate-only query. The runtime application of these algorithms is defined by PLFM-9757.
name: FacetPostProcessingAlgorithm

enum.name: ROUNDING
enum.description: Facet counts are rounded to obscure exact values.

enum.name: NOISE
enum.description: Random noise is added to facet counts to obscure exact values.
